summary.prose: The build adds a small hook registry to the daemon's tool executor and wires it in at the two places where a tool call succeeds. It is built bottom-up: the types first, then the registry and its run point with its unit tests, then the executor stage, then the callTool pass-through, and last the contract checks and docs. No rule is registered by this Story, so nothing a caller sees changes until s7 registers the first ones.
